stories.title: £2.5m cottage to be demolished for housing scheme and HyNet pipeline route in Ewloe
stories.summary: The demolition of a £2.5m cottage to make way for a large potential housing development and the Hynet carbon capture pipeline in Ewloe has been given the green light. stories.title: Betsi Cadwaladr approves £6.6m for permanent Emergency Department staff
stories.summary: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board has approved up to £6.6m to recruit permanent doctors, nurses and healthcare support workers across its three Emergency Departments. stories.title: Crown Estate reports £210m Wales profit as Plaid Cymru presses for devolution of its powers
stories.summary: The Crown Estate has published its annual Wales Review, reporting £210m in operating profit from its Welsh assets during 2025/2026, though the bulk of that figure came from time-limited fees that have now ended. stories.title: Two vehicles seized on A55 near Broughton after drivers ‘appeared to be racing’
stories.summary: Two vehicles have been seized by North Wales Police after officers spotted them appearing to race along the A55 near Broughton. stories.title: Saltney Ferry residents unable to register with a GP, Senedd told
stories.summary: Residents in Saltney Ferry are unable to register with a GP and are crossing the border into England to access primary care, a north Wales MS has told the Senedd.
